basic_details.job_title: STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) has released the STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 Notification to fill 9 Junior Hindi Translator posts under Advt. No. 2(1)/I/STPI-HQ/2026-27. This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for candidates with a Master's degree in Hindi/English or an equivalent qualification along with the prescribed translation experience. The selected candidates will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 35,400 to Rs. 1,12,400 per month, and the maximum age limit is 30 years. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official STPI website on

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 30 years Age Relaxation for Government Servants up to five years in accordance with the instructions or orders issued by the Central Government.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree in Hindi/ English or any subject with Hindi/English as compulsory/elective subject or medium of examination, or Diploma/Certificate in translation with 2 years experience.
qualification.details: Master's degree from a recognized University in Hindi with English as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level. Master's degree from a recognized University in English with Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at degree level. Master's degree from a recognized University in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi medium and English as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level. Master's degree from a recognized University in any subject other than Hindi or English, with English medium and Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level. Master's degree from a recognized University in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi and English as a compulsory or elective subjects or either of the two as a medium of examination and the other as a compulsory or elective subject at degree level. Recognized Diploma or Certificate Course in translation from Hindi to English and vice-versa or two years' experience of translation work from Hindi to English and vice-versa in Central Government or State Government office, including Government of India Undertaking.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of STPI to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 is 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Hindi Translator post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies announced for the Junior Hindi Translator post by the Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Hindi Translator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Hindi with English or vice-versa, or a Master's degree in any other subject with Hindi/English as a compulsory or elective subject. A recognized diploma or certificate in translation with two years of experience is also acceptable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Junior Hindi Translator post is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable for Government Servants as per Central Government instructions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Hindi Translator position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Junior Hindi Translator post will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 35400 to Rs. 112400 per month, corresponding to Level 6.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General and OBC categories. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 will primarily involve a Written Examination.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: While the specific age relaxation for reserved categories like SC/ST/OBC is not detailed in the provided summary, age relaxation is explicitly mentioned for Government Servants up to five years.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the STPI Junior Hindi Translator post?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official STPI website or the direct application link provided in the 'Important Links' section before the last date of 07 September 2026.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is highly recommended to download and read it thoroughly before applying.
